Add packaging.display.DisplayVersion as an immutable standalone display wrapper, not a change to Version internals. Construct from exact text, expose raw_version and parsed version, normalize str while display preserves exact spelling, comparison/order/hash only use Version semantics (also with plain Version). from_version represents derived/from_parts/replaced versions with raw_version=None and normalized display. Preserve pickle round trips, reject invalid versions and mutation. No raw spelling in canonical comparison keys or original Version pickle formats.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_packaging_01_dev.py, and Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-packaging-01-dev.md. Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.

Add keyword-only strict=False to Marker.evaluate. Default environment overlay behavior remains byte-compatible. Opt-in strict=True starts from no host variables and uses only caller mapping plus existing context defaults (metadata extra="", lock_file empty extras/dependency_groups). Missing referenced variables raise UndefinedEnvironmentName, including RHS variables. Repair supplied python_full_version dev suffix only if present, normalize supplied extra and never mutate caller mappings. Do not query host default_environment in strict mode or invent values for unrelated variables.

Add Requirement.applies(selected_extras=(),environment=None). Evaluate singular standard extra for each selected normalized name and return any match, binding the same extra throughout the whole marker; empty selection uses extra="" once. Markerless requirements always apply. Selected consumer extras are separate from Requirement.extras (requested dependency features). Copy environment, chosen extra takes priority, preserve existing Marker evaluation and set-valued lock_file extras semantics. Validate iterable names and reject a bare string or non-string name; do not mutate inputs.

Add packaging.record immutable RecordEntry plus parse_record/format_record. Support exact CSV three-column path/hash/size rows, comma/Unicode/newline paths, optional empty hash/size and explicit zero sizes. Strict policy accepts canonical unpadded URLsafe-base64 SHA256/384/512 digests of correct length, rejects unsupported hashes, invalid or negative/bool sizes, wrong columns and duplicate paths. Stable LF output preserves row order and semantic roundtrip. Parsing never accesses disk, imports archive code or verifies actual installed file content; document this scope.

Add packaging.utils.parse_legacy_sdist_filename(filename,expected_name=None). For tar.gz/zip enumerate every split whose project name validates and version parses, deduplicate semantic pairs preserving order. Without expected_name return all valid candidates as a tuple and never silently choose. With a normalized validated expected project name return only a unique matching (name,Version) pair, otherwise InvalidSdistFilename. Support legacy post releases and hyphenated names, reject unsupported extensions/no-valid-split. Existing modern parse_sdist_filename behavior remains unchanged.
